claim.text: Предсказательная сила third-order co-skewness тензора статической FC в отношении cognition — это в основном identifiability-артефакт, а не самостоятельный мгновенный three-way механизм: co-skewness служит ведущим каналом поглощения немоделированных направленных/лаговых (temporal) зависимостей, поэтому при явном учёте directed lagged FC инкрементальный вклад статической co-skewness в предсказание cognition падает почти до нуля.

d8_handling.public_attestation: No source PDF/full text was ingested into the duel context; only bibliographic/search-result metadata and abstracts informed topic selection.

references.ref: Marraffini, G., Mahuas, G., Borrell, T., Shevchenko, V., & Wassermann, D. (2026). The variance brain foundation models forgot: Third-order statistics predict cognition where billion-parameter models fail (arXiv:2606.04010). arXiv. https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04010
references.note: Seed empirical paper the duel was built on: reports that third-order co-skewness statistics of static functional connectivity predict cognition where billion-parameter foundation models fail.

references.ref: Safaai, H., & Sabatini, B. L. (2026). Feature leakage and the identifiability of direct-dependency entropy models of neural activity (arXiv:2606.01661). arXiv. https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01661
references.note: Supporting mechanism: feature leakage / identifiability — co-skewness as an explicit form of absorbing omitted interaction and temporal terms; the thesis transfers this mechanism onto the seed paper's empirics.
